#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import csv
import re
import sys

# Helper to decide whether a record is a mobility dataset
def is_mobility_record(record):
    title = record.get("title", "") or ""
    keywords_list = record.get("keywords", []) or []

    # Normalise strings
    title_lower = title.lower()
    key_terms = ["mobility", "mobility", "mobile", "transport", "transit", "public transport", "bus", "train", "subway", "tram", "gtfs", "urban mobility", "cycling", "bike", "ride", "parking", "traffic", "journey", "routes"]

    # Check title
    if any(term in title_lower for term in key_terms):
        return True

    # Join keywords into lower case string
    keywords_lower = " ".join([k.lower() for k in keywords_list] if isinstance(keywords_list, list) else [keywords_list])
    if any(term in keywords_lower for term in key_terms):
        return True

    return False

def main():
    input_path = "inputs/catalog/dataeuropa_mobility_catalog_sample.json"
    output_path = "outputs/t03_mobility_catalog.csv"

    try:
        with open(input_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error reading {input_path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return

    # Prepare csv writer
    with open(output_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fout:
        writer = csv.writer(fout, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

        header = ["dataset_id", "title", "description", "publisher", "country", "formats", "license", "distribution_url", "keywords"]
        writer.writerow(header)

        for record in data:
            if not is_mobility_record(record):
                continue

            # Extract fields, leaving empty strings if missing
            dataset_id = record.get("dataset_id", "")
            title = record.get("title", "")
            description = record.get("description", "")
            publisher = record.get("publisher", "")
            country = record.get("country", "")
            formats = record.get("formats", "")
            license = record.get("license", "")
            distribution_url = record.get("distribution_url", "")
            keywords = record.get("keywords", "")

            # Keywords in the original may be list or string
            if isinstance(keywords, list):
                keywords_str = " ".join(keywords)
            else:
                keywords_str = keywords

            row = [
                dataset_id,
                title,
                description,
                publisher,
                country,
                formats,
                license,
                distribution_url,
                keywords_str,
            ]

            writer.writerow(row)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
